headline: Contested Fronts Stir as War Enters Third Day
war_summary: The third day finds the war without a victor, with the sharpest movement concentrated in a belt of contested regions. Drowned Vale recorded 11 strategic-base events in the latest two hours, including six Colonial captures, three Warden captures and two owner-loss reports; one of its 12 bases remains in the NONE state. Farranac Coast likewise posted 11 events, with six Colonial and three Warden captures, while its casualty rates accelerated for both sides. Endless Shore saw 10 events split evenly between four captures apiece and two owner-loss reports. Linn’s Mercy reported nine events, seven of them Warden captures, amid accelerating casualties. Kings Cage logged six events, five Colonial captures and one owner-loss report, with the latest event arriving at cutoff. Deadlands remained unsettled with five events, divided between three Warden and two Colonial captures. Clahstra’s four Colonial captures came alongside the packet’s heaviest local casualty-rate acceleration. Elsewhere, many regions showed no base movement and cooling enlistment activity, leaving the active fronts the chief concern for the next day’s ledger.
